metadata.description:
In this special episode of The Tribal Kitchen, we explore a unique and iron-rich traditional dish of the Bodo tribe in Assam. This extraordinary delicacy is prepared using pork liver, intestine, and Bithai (pork blood), all cooked together. We got a rare opportunity to share this meal with a Bodo family, experiencing not just their food but also their warmth, culture, and deep culinary heritage. Watch this episode to discover how tradition and taste come together in Bodo cuisine.
